entities.name: Magdalena Fernández
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Magdalena Fernández is a Venezuelan installation and media artist known for her work with light, sound, and abstractions of nature. Her work has been exhibited internationally at the Venice Biennale, the Museum of Contemporary Art, Los Angeles, and the Museum of Fine Arts, Houston.
